title: live_sessions shares one worktree listing without swapping other modules' functions for the whole process
goal: mon_sessions.live_sessions passes one worktree listing to bl_procs and bl_stall through a parameter (or a thread-local), so another kbmon panel thread never reads a placement's cached listing. Found by the SP-hxxn6fnv review (S3 on BG-6epmljwc's provisional answer g1, a runtime swap of bl_procs.worktrees and bl_stall.worktrees). Its touches name bl_procs.py and bl_stall.py, so its choice is an operator gate.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import inspect,mon_sessions as m;s=inspect.getsource(m.one_listing);print("thread-local" if ("threading.local" in s or "get_ident" in s) else "process-wide");sys.exit(0 if ("threading.local" in s or "get_ident" in s or "listing=" in inspect.getsource(m)) else 1)
